A '''Death Spiral''' was a type of attack vehicle that was used during the [[Republic Dark Age]].

==Description==
Death Spirals were cone-shaped, and contained more than a dozen concentric rings that were armed with [[Laser/Legends|laser]] turrets and [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]], with each of the rings able to rotate independently of the others.

==History==
The Death Spiral was developed by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Chagras]], who constructed several of them. Chagras's nephew [[Odion]] later constructed a Death Spiral of his own, which was much larger than the versions used by Chagras, and was controlled by actual crews, rather than remote-controlled, as Chagras's Death Spirals had been. Odion deployed the weapon during the [[Battle of Gazzari]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], and it was destroyed by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]].
